description: Generate vector embeddings from text for semantic search and similarity matching.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Vector embeddings with keys: embeddings (list of float arrays), dimension (vector size), model (model used), count (number of embeddings)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Generates vector embeddings from text input using an embedding model. Embeddings are numerical representations of text for semantic operations.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError with 'inputs': empty or invalid text list provided. ModelError: specified embedding model not available or failed. RateLimitError: embedding API rate limit exceeded. ServiceError: embedding service unavailable.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For input errors: ensure inputs is a non-empty list of strings. For model errors: check available models with list_models or use default. For rate limits: wait and retry, or reduce batch size. For service errors: check embedding service status and retry.
